notes.title: April 20, 2021 update
notes.notes: bugs fixed, sound fixed, correct window size on higher resolution display

notes.title: The journey around the world continues!
notes.notes:
Great news for puzzle funs! Three more chapters of Travel Riddles series are ready for release on Steam!
In these games you will find hundreds of new levels and artifacts in new fantastic locations. 
Besides, new bonuses, level tasks and game modes are available.
Please support us on Greenlight and these new games will be released soon.

Travel Riddles: Trip to Italy
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=885953538
Travel Riddles: Trip to Greece
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=888785513
Travel Riddles: Trip to France
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=885956128
